decisions.decision: Notifications surface as a top bar heart icon + red dot opening a dropdown panel; opening the panel marks all read
decisions.rationale: Top bar already exists and does not displace invitation cards; at v1 volume a count badge and per-item marking are unnecessary ceremony

decisions.decision: Dashboard polls GET /api/notifications every 30 seconds and fetches the full list
decisions.rationale: The creator waiting for a response is the product's emotional peak — the dot should appear unprompted. One endpoint means the panel opens with no loading state.

decisions.decision: NOTF-V2-02 (30-day notification retention) pulled forward from v2 into Phase 4
decisions.rationale: Phase 4 already builds the APScheduler cleanup job for INV-07; a second DELETE costs almost nothing versus standing scheduling up again in v2. REQUIREMENTS.md must be reclassified by the planner.

decisions.decision: Cleanup runs hourly via APScheduler in the FastAPI lifespan, guarded by a Postgres advisory lock
decisions.rationale: Celery/Redis was re-compared and rejected: a separate worker service cannot mount the Railway volume, so it could delete DB rows but not photo files, failing INV-07. The advisory lock is ~5 lines and makes the job correct at any replica count.

decisions.decision: v1 stays on a single backend container with the Railway volume mounted; migration to Railway Storage Buckets and horizontal scale-up move to the NEXT MILESTONE
decisions.rationale: User decision 2026-07-30. A Railway volume mounts to one active deployment only, so extra replicas could neither store nor serve photos — breaking shipped Phase 2 and Phase 3 features. Tracked as INFR-V2-01 in REQUIREMENTS.md.

decisions.decision: Expired invitations disappear silently from the dashboard; photo deletion failures are logged and the DB row is deleted anyway
decisions.rationale: Cards already show a days-remaining countdown (Phase 2 D-11) so there is advance warning; and one undeletable file must not stall the whole sweep, matching the existing tradeoff in delete_invitation

context_notes: Phase 4 discussion is complete and committed; no plans exist yet and no code has been written. Working tree is clean. The discussion produced 23 decisions (D-01 to D-23) in 04-CONTEXT.md across four areas: notification surface/layout, read interaction, new-notification detection, and expiry cleanup. Two scope questions were raised by the user mid-discussion and both are resolved and recorded: notification retention was pulled forward from v2, and horizontal scaling was pushed to the next milestone. The single most important thing for a resuming agent: do NOT plan anything that assumes more than one backend replica in this milestone — the photo volume pins the backend to one container until INFR-V2-01 lands.
